messages.content: Find a picnic spot in Miami.

function.name: local_fauna
function.description: Get information about fauna in a specified region. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The region or area to find information about.

species_type.description: Type of species e.g birds, mammals etc. for detailed information.

migration_season.description: Season when fauna migrate e.g spring, winter, none. Default is none.

message.content:
A great place to enjoy a picnic in Miami is **South Pointe Park**. It’s located at the southern tip of downtown Miami, right on the waterfront overlooking Biscayne Bay. The park offers spacious grassy areas, shaded picnic tables, and plenty of benches—perfect for a relaxed meal outdoors.  

If you’re looking for something a bit more secluded, consider **Lummus Park** along Ocean Drive. It has a nice mix of open lawns and shaded spots under palm trees, plus easy access to the beach if you want to combine a picnic with a swim.

Both parks have public restrooms and are dog-friendly (though dogs must be leashed). They’re especially pleasant in the early morning or late afternoon when the heat is milder. Enjoy your picnic!
